dedupe_keys.name: vues immersives 360 routes departementales et pistes cyclables departementales territoire de belfort 2020

description: Vues immersives 360° - routes départementales et pistes cyclables départementales - Territoire de Belfort - 2020 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Immersive views allow a new view of the terrain, with a 360° view of the ground around the vehicle taking the readings. Only departmental roads, departmental bike paths, flood retention basins and the Malsaucy site were surveyed in 2020. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "360° immersive views - departmental roads and departmental bike paths - Territoire de Belfort - 2020" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include pises cyclables, routes, 2020, données ouvertes, vues immersives. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
